text:
Maya: Quick FYI — I'm preparing a docs PR to add HK availability info to the 'Regions' matrix and to clarify data-sovereignty notes for HK/SG. Will also push updated localized copy for zh-HK and en-HK.
Chris: Thanks — which files will you touch? I can check platform headers + SDK samples.
Maya: Primarily /docs/regions/availability.md and /docs/sdk/headers.md plus i18n/zh-hk.yaml. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123
Leo: Ping me when PR is ready, I'll run the staging site preview and smoke test the breadcrumbs.
Maya: WIP — pushing a small markdown table change. Patch snippet:
```markdown
| Region | Data residency | Edge locations |
|--------|----------------|----------------|
| Hong Kong (HK) | Optional local cache only, primary data center in SG | HKG-edge-1, HKG-edge-2 |
```
Chris: For SDK samples, can we avoid mentioning 'HK-residency' flag until legal signs off? Ana, any concerns?
Ana: Legal: HK data sovereignty language has to avoid implying full in-country residency unless customer deploys Private. Suggest wording: 'local caching for latency; customers requiring in-country residency should use Private.'
Maya: Got it — I'll update copy to match that phrasing.
docs-bot: Deployed preview build: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/branches/4123 — includes zh-HK strings.
Leo: Looks good on preview, breadcrumb paths need small tweak: /docs/regions -> /docs/regions/availability (currently redirecting)
Maya: Fixed redirect in PR and added a test. Will request reviews from @Chris and @Ana.
Chris: Reviewing now. Small nit: SDK header example should show curl + python. Add both.
Maya: Added dual snippet. Also added i18n key comments to help localizers.
Ana: Approved the wording. :heavy_check_mark:
Chris: LGTM. :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks — merging after CI passes. I'll post here when live.
docs-bot: CI passed for PR #4123 — merged to main.
Maya: Live. Quick checklist: confirm translations pushed, update changelog, notify support.
Leo: Translations queued. I'll update the changelog entry.
Maya: Thanks everyone! Closing the loop. :party:
